description: Create a series: AutoShort makes a video on this niche and brief every scheduleIntervalDays, and can auto-post it. Creating or changing a series is FREE. While active, the scheduler makes one video every scheduleIntervalDays (the first at its next run, within about 30 minutes) and charges each video like any video, at render — only when the balance covers it; a short balance skips that run, it never fails or overdraws. A series created or resumed through this connection counts each scheduled video against this key's daily agent spending cap (autoshort_get_limits); over the cap, that day's run is skipped. brief is what the generator writes from (topics, facts, tone) — put the user's own words here. Set startPaused: true to create it without generating yet (resume with autoshort_resume_series). Auto-post needs the platform connected (autoshort_get_connection_status); TikTok auto-post goes to Drafts.

autoPostTikTok.description: Sends each video to the creator's TikTok Drafts.

brief.description: What every video in this series is about — the generator writes from this.

defaultDuration.description: Seconds per video; 90 needs a paid plan.

madeForKids.description: COPPA answer for YouTube uploads from this series. Ask the user.

motionMixLevel.description: AI motion: some scenes of every video are animated with Seedance, the rest stay images; each video is still a complete multi-scene video with voice and captions, never a single clip. Default NONE. Price per video at 30 s: NONE 40 credits per video; HOOK up to 80 credits per video (1 animated scene); HIGHLIGHTS up to 160 credits per video (3 animated scenes); CINEMATIC up to 240 credits per video (5 animated scenes). Animated scenes whose clip cannot start fall back to stills and are not charged. Accounts that have not paid yet can use only NONE or HOOK. If a run cannot afford or start the chosen level it makes the normal NONE video instead.

voiceId.description: A voice id from autoshort_list_options (premium voices cost extra per video).
